Shows rivers, mountains, towns, and roads in Mengjin Xian, Henan Province. Cover title. Manuscript on silk. Labels pasted on to show physical features. Oriented with north to the bottom. Pictorial map. Relief shown pictorially. Hummel purchase 1934, no. 26. Includes text. Scale ca. 1:25,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
